questions.question: A managed service for real-time processing of streaming data at any scale. It can continuously capture gigabytes of data per second from many sources such as application logs, IoT telemetry, and clickstreams.
A serverless interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. There is no infrastructure to manage — you pay only for the queries that you run.
A serverless ETL service and centralized data catalog that discovers your data, transforms it, and makes it available for search and querying without the need to manage infrastructure.
A managed big data platform that makes it easy and cost-effective to run Apache Hadoop, Spark, HBase, Presto, and other frameworks to process vast amounts of data.
A fast, cloud-native BI service that makes it easy to create and publish interactive dashboards and ML-powered insights accessible from any device, including embedded in applications.

A managed search and analytics service (successor to Amazon Elasticsearch Service) that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale a search engine for log analytics, real-time application monitoring, and full-text search.
A service that makes it easy to set up, secure, and manage data lakes on Amazon S3, including data ingestion, cataloging, and fine-grained access control for analytics workloads.
A fully managed Apache Kafka service that makes it easy to ingest and process streaming data, enabling you to run Kafka workloads without managing the underlying infrastructure.
A web service that helps you reliably process and move data between different AWS compute and storage services, as well as on-premises data sources, at specified intervals.
